About关于

About Deep Research Arena.关于 Deep Research Arena。

An open benchmark for deep-research harnesses. Every harness runs the same frozen tasks on each backbone LLM in an offline sandbox, a cross-family LLM jury compares reports pairwise (Bradley-Terry), and every citation is verified against the sandbox. Code, data, and scoring are public. The board ranks harness × backbone runs by the Arena score: arena = reach^1.5 × jury win rate, with the decidable five-axis truth score reported alongside.一个面向深度研究框架的开放基准。每个框架在离线沙箱中、于每个主干模型上运行同一批冻结任务,跨家族 LLM 陪审团对报告做两两比较（Bradley-Terry）,每条引用都会按沙箱核验。代码、数据与计分全部公开。榜单按 Arena 主分对「框架 × 主干模型」运行排名:arena = 可达率^1.5 × 陪审团胜率,可判定的五轴真值分作为独立列一并展示。

Project principle项目原则

The benchmark rewards reports that can be audited. It does not assume that length, confidence, or polished prose imply truth. Every claim should point back to a reachable sandbox source.该基准奖励可被审计的报告。它不会因为篇幅、语气自信或文笔精炼就认定内容为真。每一处论断都应能追溯到可访问的沙箱来源。
